title: Economic Data Library: Free Economic and Financial Data
description:
The Economic Data Library (econdatalibrary.com) is a free, non-commercial academic data library giving students and researchers one clean, well-documented, citable place to find economic and financial statistics. It brings together economic and financial time series from international organizations (World Bank, IMF, UN, OECD, Eurostat, ECB, BIS, ILO, FAO), national statistical offices and central banks, and research datasets hosted with written permission — surfaced through a curated, continuously-growing searchable catalog.

Every series ships with producer-first attribution: the CSV header and per-series metadata carry the original producer, its license, a ready-made citation, and a link back to the authoritative source. Access is via the website, a free REST API, an MCP server for AI assistants, Python and R clients. This record is the citable reference for the library; the compilation and documentation are CC BY 4.0, while each underlying series remains governed by its original producer's terms (surfaced per-series; non-redistributable sources are not served).

Part of the ElkassabgiData family of research libraries (elkassabgidata.com).
